'''Proton cannons''' were a type of weapon emplacement used by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One model was the Separatist [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon]], which could walk. A few of them could bring down a small Republic cruiser as seen in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. The cannons had small rapid-fire turrets on their bottom side. They came in two variants: With legs, and without legs but rails. Also, they could destroy most enemies with one shot.
